title: MedUIGym: Evaluating and Training GUI Agents for Clinical Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2611.30983v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automating clinical workflows requires vision-language agents that can navigate dense graphical user interfaces (GUIs) in electronic health records (EHRs) and execute precise actions, yet many medical agents still rely on text or structured tool calls. In this work, we introduce MedUIGym, a scalable interactive environment comprising 15,739 tasks from 17 benchmark sources across six clinical task families for training and evaluating clinical GUI agents. In MedUIGym, agents perceive EHR states from screenshots and execute mouse-and-keyboard actions, as well as a paired native-tool interface over identical clinical data. The environment verifies both final answers and required clinical actions, and supports parallel trajectory collection for training. Benchmarking twelve vision-language models shows that current agents struggle across diverse clinical workflows, and simply increasing reasoning effort fails to yield consistent gains. Furthe

translated_title: MedUIGym：面向临床工作流的GUI智能体评估与训练
translated_abstract: 自动化临床工作流程需要能够导航电子健康记录（EHR）中密集的图形用户界面（GUI）并执行精确操作的视觉语言智能体，然而许多医疗智能体仍然依赖文本或结构化工具调用。在这项工作中，我们提出了MedUIGym，这是一个可扩展的交互式环境，包含来自17个基准来源、涵盖六个临床任务类别的15,739个任务，用于训练和评估临床GUI智能体。在MedUIGym中，智能体通过屏幕截图感知EHR状态并执行鼠标和键盘操作，同时还可基于相同的临床数据使用配套的原生工具接口。该环境能够验证最终答案和所需的临床操作，并支持并行轨迹收集以用于训练。对十二个视觉语言模型的基准测试表明，当前的智能体在多样化的临床工作流程中表现不佳，而单纯增加推理力度也无法带来一致的提升。
tldr: MedUIGym是一个包含15,739个任务的可扩展交互式环境，通过让智能体基于屏幕截图感知电子健康记录状态并执行鼠标键盘操作来训练和评估临床GUI智能体，基准测试显示现有视觉语言模型在多样化临床工作流程中表现不佳。
en_tdlr: MedUIGym is a scalable interactive environment with 15,739 tasks for training and evaluating clinical GUI agents that perceive EHR states from screenshots and execute mouse-and-keyboard actions, with benchmarking showing that current vision-language models struggle across diverse clinical workflows.
